fields.label: Describe the image you want
fields.value: Create one premium ecommerce lifestyle photo for this desk lamp. Keep the exact product shape, materials, color, label, and proportions unchanged. Place it in a calm late-afternoon desk scene where the lamp casts a believable pool of light on the work surface. Keep the full base, stem, hinge, shade, and control fully visible and sharp. Make the product the main focus with realistic light, believable shadows, clean composition, and room for a crop. Do not add invented readable text, claims, extra products, watermarks, retailer logos, or a plain empty background.
